Uses a plain browser User-Agent: yes.bank.in silently drops requests carrying this project's identifying client token (they hang until timeout) while answering identical requests with a plain browser UA in under a second (checked 27 Sep 2026). Confirmed live and current on 2026-09-27: a fresh direct download of this exact PDF (207,966 bytes, HTTP 200) fed through the real adapter produced 36 rows effective 2026-06-02, matching the checked-in fixture exactly. Caveat found while confirming: this project's own fetchDoc -- specifically its self-identifying User-Agent string (contains 'FixedReturnTracker/1.0 (+https://github.com/...)') -- reliably hangs to a DOMException timeout against this URL from this sandbox, while the identical request with an ordinary browser User-Agent (no other header changed) succeeds in under a second, repeatedly; this looks like a stealth anti-bot rule keyed on the UA string rather than a general site outage (the previous engineer's own notes already flagged this bank's PDFs as slow to download). Not yet known whether GitHub Actions' UA/IP is treated the same way -- worth reconfirming there rather than assuming it behaves identically to this sandbox.

www.idbibank.in and www.idbi.bank.in both returned HTTP 502 to every direct-fetch attempt from this sandbox on 2026-09-27 (two domain aliases, a first pass and a brief polite retry ~20 minutes later); the platform's browser tool also could not hold a stable session for this page in this run (repeated cross-session content bleed). Built and tested instead from a genuine copy of the same official page via the Internet Archive Wayback Machine: https://web.archive.org/web/20260730071451id_/https://www.idbi.bank.in/interest-rates.aspx (captured 2026-07-30, the most recent HTTP-200 capture found via the CDX API on 2026-09-27). Covers the retail (<₹3 crore) General/Senior Citizen slabs plus the Tax Saving FD (5yr), Vasundhara Green Deposit (1111 days) and Aarogya Fixed Deposit (370 days, general-only) named schemes read from the same table, and (best-effort, not required) the promotional Utsav FD / IDBI Chiranjeevi Super Senior Citizen FD 555/700-day buckets, which the bank's own page said were 'extended up to Sept 30, 2026' as of the archived copy -- may have lapsed by the time this runs; the adapter warns rather than fails if that specific pair of tables is gone. GitHub Actions runs from a different network and may reach the live page directly; robots.txt could not be checked from this sandbox either (also 502; an Internet Archive capture of it returned an inconclusive redirect).
